title: Can the possessed pawn gather / loot by himself?
intro: No fight nearby. You position the possessed main pawn, press End, and the test asks the game to have HIM interact (the way AI pawns do). Hands off for 6 s after each End.

steps.text: GATHER: stand the pawn within 2 m of a herb / ore / gather spot, Arisen well away. Press End, then hands off
Asking the game: pawn, gather it. WATCH: does he gather? Does an item pop-up appear?
steps.each_frame:
local KEY, PAT = "g", "^gm"

if not INT then INT = { done = {} } end
if not INT.done[KEY] then
  INT.done[KEY] = true
  local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.InteractManager")
  local pw = H.pawn(0)
  local pp = pw:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
  local best, bd, bn
  for _, s in ipairs(im:get_field("InteractiveObjects"):get_field("_entries"):get_elements()) do
    local ok, o = pcall(s.get_field, s, "Value"); if not (ok and o) then ok, o = pcall(s.get_field, s, "value") end
    if ok and o then pcall(function()
      local go = o:get_field("<Owner>k__BackingField")
      local nm = tostring(go:call("get_Name"))
      local p = go:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
      local d = math.sqrt((p.x - pp.x) ^ 2 + (p.y - pp.y) ^ 2 + (p.z - pp.z) ^ 2)
      if d < 4 and nm:find(PAT) and (not bd or d < bd) then best, bd, bn = o, d, nm end
    end) end
  end
  if best then
    local ok, r = pcall(im.call, im, "requestInteractFromAI(app.InteractiveObject, System.UInt32, app.Character)", best, 0, pw)
    INT.req = ok and r or nil
    INT.last = string.format("%s %.1f m sent=%s", bn, bd, tostring(ok))
  else
    INT.last = "nothing matching within 4 m"
  end
end

expect.label: gather: game says he is interacting

steps.text: LOOT: stand the pawn within 2 m of a lootable corpse or a chest (kill something first if needed). Press End, then hands off
Asking the game: pawn, loot it. WATCH: does he loot?

steps.text: Remember what you saw (gathered? looted? whose inventory?). Press End

probes.req:
if not (INT and INT.req) then return nil end
local ok, v = pcall(function() local r = INT.req:get_field("Result"); return type(r) == "userdata" and r:get_field("value__") or r end)
return ok and tostring(v) or "?"
probes.interacting: local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.InteractManager"); local pw = H.pawn(0); return pw and im:call("isInteracting(app.Character)", pw)
probes.p_act: local n = H.node(H.pawn(0)); return n ~= nil and not tostring(n):find('Locomotion', 1, true)
